model.title: A bill to designate the General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Timothy Kaine (D-VA)

summary.text: The bill would designate the General George C. Marshall House in Leesburg, Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System to honor the historic legacy of George C. Marshall, who served as Army Chief of Staff during World War II and later held positions including Secretary of State, Secretary of Defense, and president of the American Red Cross. The measure would assign management responsibility to the George C. Marshall International Center and allow the Department of the Interior to provide technical assistance and financial support for the site's interpretation, preservation, and marketing.
